title: People - 1.0
excerpt: A stray hostel conversation about language, politics, and knowing when to stop.
body:
When I was travelling recently to Udagamandalam for work , I was staying out of GoStops and Zostel cause I like to excercise my social skills from time to time than sitting isolated in a cubicle space that has no life or human buzz in it for hours at a stretch everyday like asif thats an achievement for years.

I had the pleasure (~) of connecting with a few gentlemen ( or so was my thought ).
One owned a construction comapany, Second was an ev automobile designer from some ~ finnish company - working from India and the other was this human who was working at a temple doing purohitam in a good old temple in Tamilnadu - I genuinely did not know why he was hanging out with them , not much was about him other than that.

The next day , This really fine evening I felt like I needed to wrap some work up for a new company's website and all , I wantedly isolated myself to the centre table left empty out on the lawn, only to learn why later.

While the first 2 guys gosspied betwee peeping at me for a plot from a distance and approached to join me putting their wireless speaker that played some utterly irrelevant music - imo , and a pack of cigerette and a bottle of cheap alcohol on the table with a few glasses and ash tray, asking if they could join me. Responded with an anticipation of somehting brewing up  "sure why not".

They started a topic that I ( & most others similar ) hate to talk about in public or discuss my opinions as its a lot more than complicated than what my governemnt can ever grow the balls to solve - understandably aswell I guess. "what is your take on DMK and Vijay Stepping up in power shiva" he asked . I took my time and answered after gaining his curiosity to make sure I puss hinm off that " well, its something I dont really care enough to talk about " I sniffed both were DMK affiliated , and active contributors to the system - in ways they work. I started working again as time was of essence but  they wanted to make sure I rope me back in the conversation as they clearly had a goal at this point.

" I wouldnt have gotten this job if computer science was not introduced in TN by our kalaignar " 1 said to 2 , "BJP hates TN but also knows not to mess with them as they have really sharp horns that root back to decades of knowing what people want and carefully attending to every individual's needs ......." he went non stop. I stuck to my work and now I was really running out of time to wrap it up. He then adds looking at me " becasue of people like you who support BJP is why DMK is not able to perform Shiva, dont you think so ? " , I did not care, then he turns to the second guy who I think has been the architect " what ddo you think he asked him " he as per the script said " I dont know , dont pull me into this bro " I did not want to spare him for it but said " I have actually important works to do and dont have time to waste so good luck finding someone who actually cares how good dmk performs vs the BJP " 


now , I dont have an issue about a few humans "casually conversing" a very sensitive topic, what people fail to understand with the art of conversation and what it really means. When one rots out of points and soars around like a noisy child and the other steps away not wishing to pariticipate in an oblivious exchange - that is the time when a conversation has to stop saving their faces. but no they came to the table I had changed to inside the common space of the dorm and joined me showing a clear trend. At this point I was a bit saturated and had started the compilation of not just the code but also the answers to revert so so cruely that I make them feel bad about opening their mouth.
And I did go on and on with full facts, figures, timelines, intends, impacts, results, comparisons and I could see their faces shrink by the non stop burst of points I was accumulating as I was bug fixing my code. 

One point I can take away - just one atall form the unfortunate exitance of DMK is that , If they did not exist, BJP would have most certainly ruinied the way TN was build and exists. I argue unbiased. my points are always biased towards the merits and its weights in the nature of the conversation and the very parameters themselves. The hindi imposition is unacceptable by me. that is a bias/point I will hold with unshakable weight. I do not respect a language that was, by a cold-hearted bunch of baboons, imposed in the very worst methods that cruelty can bring into existence into a conquered society. Hindi was suffocated down India's throat killing multiple beautiful regional languaage to extinction across may north Indian states today. Langauge that showed the elegance and beauty of that society , culture and harmony - wiped out with no ounce of respect for good. 

I am from a society that prays our language in the form of God - Murugan - the son of Lord Shiva - the God of War , aswell. He was a the supreme alchemist, someone who's mere creation was to gaurd knowledge - which was Tamil in itself.  Tamil today has been reduced to so many aspects , yet none were able to wipe it out from existance, It grew rather. Karunanidhi had one and one good trait atall , his love to the language that he wielded to make himself the family that exists today. That prevented a lott of steps of the centra' govenrment's imposition of Hindi down south's throarts. To this occasional shielding with which they majorly sailed their boats as a regional political party. I did learn hindi to some extent , I do converse in them with my friends and lately there has been trouble in such waters but it was never significant. They do get aggitated when I have trouble in understanding certain parts and when I ask them to explain it in english, they do it with a reluctance that rubs me like I'm an ignorant human. Some have been kind ofcourse. Do we really need this ? should these complications really exist ? is this what we as a coutnry should be solving right now at this era ?
